title: Verdicts and reviews
summary: Verdicts automatically link the actual plan execution and concrete artifact ids. A deployment verdict re-evaluates active frozen-target acceptance after commit. An aborted or errored execution stays terminal while its completed captures receive independent verdicts; the stop wakes the capture session, or every member it answers for once that session ended, and the stage blocker names yoke qa plan review-begin until the review is submitted. A reviewed pass settles a case only while it judges the case's newest capture. A recorded verdict batch cancels its review wake. Re-entering the plan runner reprints passing verdicts instead of capturing those requirements again; a failed or undetermined verdict stays open, so re-entry begins a fresh capture. A one-shot pass on a blocking requirement names the tree it verified as `verification_tree.head_sha` in its raw_result JSON; prose is refused because the terminal gate cannot read a commit from it. Review-begin and the returned artifact-read commands reach the paired serving evidence plane from admin connections; a missing or unavailable plane refuses with recovery instead of using a different local store. A pass recorded from outside the run credits a deployment stage only with its evidence attached to that run (yoke qa artifact add --requirement-id N --run-id RUN --artifact-type command_output --content-file PATH); a bare pass reads passed_without_evidence and names the run.
